title: init.behavior: gitignore the route .malfunctions dir
description:
## .what

`init.behavior` should gitignore the route's `.malfunctions/` dir when it scaffolds the route.

## .why

the route reminder daemon writes a crash log for every failed reach into
`$route/.malfunctions/daemon.driveon._.crash.n<index>.log` (bhrain:
`domain.operations/route/reminder/getRouteReminderCrashLogPath.js`). no init ignores that dir, so
every crash log is a tracked candidate, and they land in pull requests.

measured on uladkasach/dev-env-setup#167: **96 crash logs** were committed into one route's
`.malfunctions/`, about half of the route's 141 files. the commander's review asked for them gone and
for the dir ignored at the source.

## .the shape of the fix

init.behavior already writes a per-dir ignore for the other runtime dirs, for example
`review/self/.gitignore`:

```
# ignore all self-review files
*
!.gitignore
```

do the same for `.malfunctions/` at init: findsert `$route/.malfunctions/.gitignore` with `*` and
`!.gitignore`, so the dir exists, stays ignored, and a crash log can never be staged by `--unstaged include`.

⚠️ the dir is written by bhrain's daemon and scaffolded by bhuild's init, so this needs the two to
agree on the path. `getRouteReminderCrashLogPath` already owns it (one builder), so the init can
import it or match it.

## .acceptance

- a fresh `init.behavior` route holds `.malfunctions/.gitignore`
- `git status` after a daemon crash shows no new file
- a route scaffolded before the fix gets the ignore on its next init/bind (findsert, idempotent)

## .origin
